answer:
NEMSU's history:
- 1982: Bukidnon State College (now Bukidnon State University) opened an extension in Tandag City, the Bukidnon External Studies Center, with 153 pioneering students.
- 1992: Republic Act 7377 created Surigao del Sur Polytechnic College (SSPC), joining the Tandag center with schools in Cagwait, Tagbina, Lianga and San Miguel.
- 1998: Republic Act 8628 made it Surigao del Sur Polytechnic State College and added the Cantilan campus.
- 2010: Republic Act 9998 converted it into Surigao del Sur State University (SDSSU).
- 2018: An agreement with the University of Southeastern Philippines led to the gradual turnover of the Bislig campus.
- 2021: Republic Act 11584 renamed SDSSU to North Eastern Mindanao State University (NEMSU).

Full story: https://nemsu.edu.ph/about/university
